basic_info.description: For the first time in three generations, 49 Vista Verde Ct is on the market! Located in a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully maintained detached home features original hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and a gorgeous chandelier in the dining room. The property offers stunning city views and an expansive yard that's currently being landscapedperfect for outdoor living and entertaining.The home also features a two-car side-by-side garage, an expansive driveway for additional parking, and an unfinished room in the garage with plenty of storage nooksideal for hobbies or future expansion.    With a two-car side-by-side garage, a large driveway, and an unfinished room in the garage with ample storage nooks, this home offers plenty of space and potential. This is a rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in a peaceful neighborhood. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of history in one of San Francisco's hidden gems!
